instruction: A candid documentary medium-wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor, white walls, and white floor markers. On the left, the man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands in profile, facing right with a neutral expression. On the right, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing him, punching his stomach with her right fist. The room is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
